summary: Loads a mesh data file (or an embedded sub-block of a parent context a3) into the shared read buffer dword_8B8F30, parses the header into this+0x0 (flags), this+0x4 (scale, inverted to 1.0/scale), this+0x8 (dimension) and the name string at this+28, then parses either material blocks (flags bit 2, descriptor arrays of 12 and 8 bytes with 36-byte elements) or texture/animation blocks (flags bit 1, 44-byte descriptors with 32-byte frames) via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 buffer reads. Returns 0 on success, -1 on a short read, freeing the temporary buffers on the way out.

operations.description: If the context a3 is present and the header byte at (a3+296) + ((a3+292)<<8) has bit 0x10 set, load the embedded sub-block; otherwise fall through to the file-based path.
Sub-block path: allocate dword_8B8F30 of the block size at +8 and dword_8B8F34 of the size at +12 via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Read the block into dword_8B8F34 via ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f; on a short read free both temporary buffers and return -1.
Post-process the read block via sub_59B260(dword_8B8F34, size).

File path: query the file size at the current position via FileSizeQueryWrapper, seek to the end via sub_587F64(a2, 0, 2), compute the file length as the size delta, and seek back to the original position.
Allocate dword_8B8F30 for the full file length via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and read it via ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f; on a short read free it and return -1.

Parse the header from the shared buffer via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0: the 16-byte name block at this+28, the flags dword at this+0x0, the scale float at this+0x4 and the value at this+0x8; then invert the scale (this+0x4 = 1.0/scale) and process the name via sub_589901.

Material-block path: when flags at this+0x0 have bit 2 set, read the block count at this+0x14, allocate a 12-byte-element descriptor array via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zero-initialize each element via StructZeroInit_93b0, and store the array at this+0x18.

For each material block, read its sub-entry count via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0, allocate a 2-dword sub-entry header array, zero-initialize each entry via DualFieldZeroInit, store it in the block element, then read per-sub-entry element counts and allocate and fill the 36-byte element arrays via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0.

Texture/animation path: else when flags at this+0x0 have bit 1 set, read the block count at this+0xC, allocate a 44-byte-element descriptor array via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initialize each element via StructInitWithVtableZero, and store the array at this+0x10.

For each texture/animation block, read the header region (32 bytes plus two dwords) via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0, allocate a 32-byte-element frame array, initialize each frame via sub_5507A0, read the frame data, then overwrite each frame float with index * scale (this+0x4); update the maximum sub-entry count at this+0x14.
Texture path epilogue: set this+0x8 = (sub-entry count at this+0x14) * scale (this+0x4).
Free the temporary read buffers dword_8B8F30 and dword_8B8F34 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when they are set.
Return 0 on success, or -1 when a read returned fewer bytes than requested.

clean_pseudocode: int MeshDataFileLoader(float* this, int handle, int ctx) {
if (arr) { *arr = blocks; for (i = 0; i < blocks; ++i) StructZeroInit_93b0(arr + 1 + 3*i); }
if (sub) { *sub = subs; for (j = 0; j < subs; ++j) DualFieldZeroInit(sub + 1 + 2*j); }
if (arr) { *arr = blocks; for (i = 0; i < blocks; ++i) StructInitWithVtableZero(arr + 1 + 11*i); }
if (fa) { *fa = frames; for (j = 0; j < frames; ++j) sub_5507A0((DWORD*)(fa + 1 + 8*j)); }
unresolved: The exact semantics of ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 (buffer cursor reads advancing a shared position) are inferred from its repeated use as the file-to-struct reader; not confirmed independently.
The meaning of the sub-block in the context pointer a3 (data pointer at +296 combined with a byte index at +292<<8) and the purpose of the header bit 0x10 are not established by this packet.
The nature of the 16-byte name string at this+28 processed by sub_589901 is unknown.
The per-frame float fill (index * scale) overwrites data read from the file; whether that data is a fallback or a separate quantity is unresolved.
The material-array allocation path reads the per-sub-entry count and fills 36-byte arrays, but the element layout is not established beyond the sizes.
